verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs show programmable automatic responses to inbound events: incoming calls can be answered, gather input, record and take payments with no human involved (twilio-docs-23). Community reports describe TwiML bins and Twilio Functions as hosted logic that reacts to incoming SMS or calls, though with limits such as no email action (twilio-comm-11), plus voicemail-to-webhook automation (twilio-comm-15). Event Streams (twilio-docs-8) only delivers events to other destinations and is a building block rather than a rule engine. missing for 10: a documented no-code or declarative rule/workflow builder (event → condition → action), coverage of trigger types beyond inbound calls and messages, AI-native rule authoring, and first-party docs detailing Functions or TwiML-bin automation.
